caption: The drawing depicts a wrought and cast iron balcony railing composed of intricate geometric and floral patterns. The railing includes vertical and horizontal bars intersected by decorative circular and floral medallions. There are symmetrical, curved elements that form repeating diamond and X-shaped patterns, accented with stylized leaves extending from the intersections. The top and bottom horizontal bars are embellished with small circular floral motifs placed at regular intervals. Below the railing, a balcony floor is indicated with parallel horizontal lines and shaded cross-hatching, supported underneath by multiple brackets fixed into a brick wall. The entire drawing is rendered in black ink on a cream-colored background and is enclosed within a simple rectangular border. Below the drawing, the caption “Wrought and Cast Iron Balcony Railing” is written in a decorative, hand-lettered style.
title: Balcony Railing
